name: Windows Anonymous SAM Enumeration Restricted
description:
Ensures anonymous users cannot enumerate SAM accounts (RestrictAnonymousSAM = 1).
Required Windows permission (remedy only): LEA agent account must be allowed to run only: reg add HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa /v RestrictAnonymousSAM (administrator rights) via a delegated run-as permission, Scheduled Task, or service configuration.

remedy.command: reg add HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa /v RestrictAnonymousSAM /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f | Out-Null; reg query HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa /v RestrictAnonymousSAM
